:::{#exr-rank-product-right-practice}
#### Finding how large the rank of a product can be from its right factor

@thm-rank-product-right shows how large the [rank](linear-algebra-subspaces.qmd#def-rank) of a [matrix product](linear-algebra-matrices.qmd#def-matrix-mult)
can be, given the rank of its right factor.
Let $\matr{A}$ be any $3 \times 2$ [matrix](linear-algebra-matrices.qmd#def-matrix), and let

$$
\matr{B} = \sbmat{1 & 1 \\ 1 & 1}.
$$

Find the number that, by @thm-rank-product-right, $\rankf{\matr{A}\matr{B}}$ cannot exceed, whatever $\matr{A}$ is.

::: {.callout-tip}
#### Hint

Find $\rankf{\matr{B}}$ first.

:::

:::
